build_finish_time: max over jobs of (gh_build_started_at + valid positive duration or repo p95/global p95 fallback + finish buffer)
history_rule: only same-repository builds whose derived finish time is strictly earlier than current trigger/start time; ties among completed builds are ordered by finish time, trigger time, then build id

tier_d_exploratory_challenge.evaluation: same five expanding walk-forward folds; macro within-repository metrics primary; report every variant
tier_d_exploratory_challenge.same_commit_rule: prior build of same trigger SHA must have derived finish strictly before current trigger
tier_d_exploratory_challenge.normalization_rule: log1p feature z-score against same-repository builds that derived-finished strictly before current trigger
tier_d_exploratory_challenge.balanced_rf_rule: inverse training-repository build count, normalized to mean weight one
tier_d_exploratory_challenge.normalization_correction: Dnorm preliminary parts retained but superseded by DnormV2 because git_diff_test_churn is identically zero and its derived z-score is undefined

frozen_before_confirmation: rank_xendcg objective with repo x calendar-month queries
equal z-blend of ranker and binary LightGBM using training-score moments
global Platt map fit on training scores
tier_e_protocol.stream_definition: PR builds: (repo, gh_pull_req_num); push builds: (repo, git_branch)
tier_e_protocol.outcome_rule: stream and tr_prev_build outcomes used only if that build derived-finished strictly before current trigger
tier_e_protocol.inflight_rule: counts and flags use only the existence/start time of earlier-started builds, never their outcome
tier_e_protocol.job_count_rule: build-matrix size fixed at build creation; reported with and without (Enojobs) for provenance
tier_e_protocol.verification: _assert_stream_history brute-force recomputation on 40 sampled repositories every walk run
fold6_development_variants_tried: RF/LGBM binary on C, C+S, C+S+I, C+S+I+J

walk_tier_c_shuffle_control.purpose: additional null distribution; no model selection

random_score_sanity_control.scores: independent uniform random scores over saved fixed test predictions

per_project_online_protocol.resampling: RandomOverSampler on transformed training fold only; no test resampling
per_project_online_protocol.skip_rule: skip a repository-fold with no failed build in train or test

unavailable_requested_features.committer_history: clean.parquet contains no stable committer/account identifier
unavailable_requested_features.file_level_failure_history: clean.parquet contains aggregate diff counts but no changed-file paths
unavailable_requested_features.change_type_indicators: clean.parquet contains no file paths or file-type flags from which CI/config/dependency changes can be derived

duration_fallback.global_fallback: positive-duration p95 if repository p95 unavailable
